title_or_table: American Community Survey 1-year estimates, Table B19082, Shares of Aggregate Household Income by Quintile
observation_period: Calendar year 2025 (income in the past 12 months, collected through 2025)
universe_or_base: Households, ranked by household income and split into fifths; the top 5 percent row is a part of the highest fifth
unit: share_of_income_pct is each group's percent of all household income; share_of_households_pct is the group's percent of households (20 for each fifth, 5 for the top 5 percent); moe_pct is the 90 percent margin of error in percentage points
qualification: Survey estimates of money income before taxes, not counting noncash benefits; the fifths add to 100 percent, and the top 5 percent sits inside the highest fifth

share_of_households_pct.description: share of households in the group

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 1-year estimates, Table B19082, shares of aggregate household income by quintile, 2025, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Survey estimates of pretax money income; margins of error are 0.08 points or less.
